summary: For any kappa,r,epsilon>0 an explicit probability density rho<=1 supported on a curved slab of volume one has r<=V<=2r and kappa U+W^2/(2V) in [0,epsilon] almost surely. Hence the desired r^(3/2)|E|^(1/2) shared-shear Borel tube cannot follow from an arbitrary 3D joint-density cap. This does not refute QFORM because the engineered joint law is not asserted to be an orthogonal projection of a cap-one product law. The remaining theorem must spend original product-projection provenance before the curved trace.
